result.instructions: Tools for SignWell, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a draft from this contract PDF for jane@example.com and show me the draft before we send it."; "Which of our documents are still waiting for a signature?"; "Send a reminder to the recipients who have not signed the NDA yet.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SignWell data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run signwell_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run signwell_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run signwell_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. signwell_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: signwell_get_credentials
tools.title: Show the connected account
tools.description: Show the SignWell user, role and account behind the API token. Good first call to confirm the connection. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/me.

tools.name: signwell_get_account
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the account settings for this SignWell account. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/account.

tools.name: signwell_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document with its status, recipients and fields. Use it to check whether a document is still a draft, sent, or completed. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/documents/{id}.

document_id.description: Document id from SignWell (for example, from signwell_create_document).

tools.name: signwell_get_completed_pdf_link
tools.title: Get the completed PDF link
tools.description: Get a download link (file_url) for the completed, signed PDF of a document. The link comes from SignWell. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/completed_pdf?url_only=true.

document_id.description: Document id from SignWell (for example, from signwell_create_document).

tools.name: signwell_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template with its placeholders and fields. Check the placeholder ids before creating a document from it. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/document_templates/{id}.

template_id.description: Template id from SignWell (create templates in the SignWell app).

tools.name: signwell_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks (event callbacks) registered on this account. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/hooks.

tools.name: signwell_list_bulk_sends
tools.title: List bulk sends
tools.description: List bulk sends (one CSV upload that creates many documents). Optional filters: user_email, api_application_id. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/bulk_sends.

user_email.description: Only bulk sends created by this user.

api_application_id.description: Only bulk sends created by this API application.

tools.name: signwell_get_bulk_send
tools.title: Get a bulk send
tools.description: Get one bulk send with its status. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/bulk_sends/{id}.

tools.name: signwell_get_bulk_send_documents
tools.title: List documents of a bulk send
tools.description: List the documents created by one bulk send. SignWell API: GET /api/v1/bulk_sends/{id}/documents.

annotations.title: List documents of a bulk send

tools.name: signwell_create_document
tools.title: Create a draft document
tools.description: Create a DRAFT document from public file URLs. Nothing is emailed: call signwell_send_document to send it. Each created document counts toward API billing unless test_mode is true. SignWell API: POST /api/v1/documents with draft=true.

file_url.description: Public https URL of a .pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx or image file.

files.description: One or more files to sign.

id.description: Your id for this recipient, for example "1". Each recipient id must be unique.

recipients.description: Recipients who sign. Send happens later.

subject.description: Email subject for the signature request.

message.description: Email message for the signature request.

test_mode.description: Test mode: the document is not legally binding and is not billed. Default false (live).

tools.name: signwell_create_document_from_template
tools.title: Create a draft document from a template
tools.description: Create a DRAFT document from a template. Nothing is emailed: call signwell_send_document to send it. Recipients fill the template placeholders; check ids with signwell_get_template. SignWell API: POST /api/v1/document_templates/documents with draft=true.

template_id.description: Template id from SignWell (create templates in the SignWell app).

id.description: Your id for this recipient, for example "1". Each recipient id must be unique.

subject.description: Email subject for the signature request.

message.description: Email message for the signature request.

test_mode.description: Test mode: the document is not legally binding and is not billed. Default false (live).

annotations.title: Create a draft document from a template

tools.name: signwell_send_document
tools.title: Send a document for signature
tools.description: SEND a draft document: SignWell emails every recipient at once. This cannot be undone. Call it only when the user asks to send. SignWell API: POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/send.

document_id.description: Document id from SignWell (for example, from signwell_create_document).

subject.description: Email subject for the signature request.

message.description: Email message for the signature request.

test_mode.description: Test mode: the document is not legally binding and is not billed. Default false (live).

tools.name: signwell_send_reminder
tools.title: Send a signing reminder
tools.description: Send a reminder email (or SMS) to recipients who have not signed yet. Omit recipients to remind everyone pending. Call it only when the user asks. SignWell API: POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/remind.

document_id.description: Document id from SignWell (for example, from signwell_create_document).

recipients.description: Recipients to remind. Omit to remind every pending recipient.

tools.name: signwell_delete_document
tools.title: Delete a document
tools.description: DELETE a document. This cannot be undone. Call it only when the user asks to delete that exact document. SignWell API: DELETE /api/v1/documents/{id}.

document_id.description: Document id from SignWell (for example, from signwell_create_document).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with SignWell
prompts.description: What you can do with SignWell here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_whether_a_document_is_a_draft_sent_or_completed
prompts.title: Check whether a document is a draft, sent or completed
prompts.description: Read one document by its id to see its status and its recipients.

prompts.name: get_a_link_to_the_signed_pdf_of_a_finished_document
prompts.title: Get a link to the signed PDF of a finished document
prompts.description: Get a download link for the completed, signed PDF of one document. The link comes from SignWell.

prompts.name: track_a_bulk_send
prompts.title: Track a bulk send
prompts.description: List the bulk sends, read one with its status, then list the documents it created.

prompts.name: create_a_draft_from_a_template
prompts.title: Create a draft from a template
prompts.description: Check the placeholder ids of a template. Create a draft document from it. Nothing is emailed until you send it.

prompts.name: send_a_draft_for_signature
prompts.title: Send a draft for signature
prompts.description: Send a draft document for signature. SignWell emails every recipient at once, and this cannot be undone.

prompts.name: remind_recipients_who_have_not_signed
prompts.title: Remind recipients who have not signed
prompts.description: Send a signing reminder to recipients who have not signed yet. Omit the recipients to remind everyone who is pending.
